news.title: Aster DM Quality Care certifies fractional share payout for QCIL amalgamation
news.description: Aster DM Quality Care Limited certified the distribution of net proceeds from fractional shares to former Quality Care India Limited shareholders. The company sold 65 consolidated fractional shares at an average price of ₹676.0669 per share on October 8, 2026. Net sale proceeds of ₹43,834.43 were available for distribution after deducting brokerage and statutory charges. An amount of ₹1,886.45 relating to eight shareholders remains undistributed due to failed remittances and is held by the company.
